This 0.20 hectare plot is my main maize field near the homestead, and I want to get a good harvest to feed my family. I will apply some urea and DAP from the cooperative, though I can only get a small amount this season, and I will also put cattle manure on it since the plot is close to home and easy to carry to. I will use improved maize seed on this important plot because it gives more grain, but I will not buy chemicals or irrigate because maize grows well with the meher rains here and chemicals are too expensive for me. My children and I will manage all the work ourselves—planting, weeding, and harvesting—so I do not need to hire anyone for such a small piece of land.
